title: Cat

steps.text: Start on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders.
steps.cue: Hands and knees, wrists under shoulders.

steps.text: Round your back up toward the ceiling and tuck your chin a little.
steps.cue: Round your back up. Tuck your chin a little.

steps.text: Press the mat away and hold for one slow breath.
steps.cue: Press the mat away. One slow breath.

steps.text: Release slowly back to a flat back.
steps.cue: Release slowly to a flat back.

mistakes: Pushing the hips back instead of rounding the spine.
regression: Make the movement smaller, or do it seated with your hands on your knees.
stopIf: Come out if your knees or wrists hurt.

anatomy.why: Rounding the back gives the muscles along the spine a gentle stretch.
